checks.title: Exactly 50 MIDI files with matching IDs across files and both CSVs
Every file parses with mido as Format 0, one track, 480 PPQ
Track name, tempo, and 4/4 time signature at tick 0; integer BPM 85-130
checks.detail: tempo compared within 0.01 BPM after microsecond rounding

checks.title: Channel 1 only; no program change, pitch bend, CC, aftertouch, or SysEx
checks.detail: every channel message is an explicit note-on or note-off on channel 1

checks.title: Explicit note-offs; every note-on paired; note-offs first on shared ticks
checks.detail: note-on/off pairing re-done from the raw message stream, independent of the builder

checks.title: One end-of-track event, last in the file, exactly on the 2, 4, or 8-bar loop boundary
Pitches 55-96, at least 90% in C4-C6 (60-84), velocities 1-127, notes inside the loop
checks.detail: 1024 notes, G3-F#6, 96.6% in the primary range

checks.title: Overlaps only in legato-labeled patterns: adjacent, different pitches, 1-60 ticks, max 2 voices
checks.detail: 29 legato patterns, 144 intentional overlaps, 21 patterns with none

checks.title: Note-event and index CSVs match the parsed MIDI exactly
checks.detail: pitch, start tick, duration, velocity, note names (MIDI 60 = C4), and beats = ticks / 480

checks.title: One chord per bar, and every Roman numeral matches its chord under the documented convention
checks.detail: 218 bars; numerals re-derived from the parallel-major convention, not from a lookup table

checks.title: Every out-of-scale melody note is listed in the index CSV
checks.detail: 56 out-of-scale note events, recomputed from tonal center + scale step patterns

checks.title: Proxy: every pattern spends at least half its sounding time on tones of its reference chords
checks.detail: lowest is 038 at 60%; this is a proxy, not a listening test

checks.title: No exact, transposed, re-velocitied, or re-tempoed duplicates
checks.detail: 1,225 pairs compared ignoring velocity and tempo; rhythm-and-duration twins: 0

checks.title: No near-duplicates by onset, pitch-class, or interval similarity
checks.detail: closest onset+pitch-class 031/035 Jaccard 0.18; closest onset+interval 035/039 0.22; closest onset grids 011/015 0.76; fail threshold 0.85

checks.title: No pattern is a shorter loop repeated unchanged, inside itself or across the pack
checks.detail: halves compared for exact and transposed repeats; every longer loop compared with every shorter one tiled

checks.title: Five groups of ten in ID order; 2, 4, and 8-bar loops all present
checks.detail: groups Neon Hooks 10, Midnight Sequences 10, Cold Signals 10, Haunted Melodies 10, Cinematic Flight 10; bars 2-bar 5, 4-bar 38, 8-bar 7

checks.title: A clean rebuild is byte-identical, and every SHA-256 in manifest.json matches
checks.detail: 56 files rebuilt in a temp folder and hashed, ZIP included; 54 manifest entries verified

checks.title: ZIP passes its CRC test and every member is byte-identical to the validated files
checks.detail: synthwave_darkwave_50_midi_leads.zip, 55 members, 38,897 bytes; the site serves the same bytes

checks.title: A second parser, @tonejs/midi, reads the same notes, tempo, meter, and loop end as the CSVs
checks.detail: 50 files, 1024 notes compared with @tonejs/midi 2.0.28 on Node v22.23.4

second_parser.name: @tonejs/midi
second_parser.compared_fields: PPQ, tempo, 4/4 time signature, track name, channel, end-of-track tick, and every note (pitch, start tick, duration, velocity, name)

limitations: Musical quality, memorability, and how a line sits in a mix are judgments. The chord-tone share is a proxy, not a listening test.
Glide on legato overlaps depends on the receiving synth's mono legato mode and portamento; it cannot be verified from MIDI.
The files were not imported into commercial DAWs in this environment. They were parsed with mido and @tonejs/midi.
The browser preview synth is a sketch of each suggested sound, not the suggested patch itself.
Near-duplicate detection compares onset, pitch-class, and interval token sets; it cannot judge perceived similarity.
reproduce: python3 scripts/build_pack.py          # stdlib only, writes midi/, CSVs, manifest, ZIP
python3 scripts/validate.py            # mido checks, writes validation_report.json
npm ci && node scripts/validate-tonejs.mjs  # second parser
